missing_spec_content.spec_text: Students should be able to use data presented in standard form.
missing_spec_content.why: The lesson never uses or presents half-life data in standard form, such as half-lives in the range of 10⁻³ s to 10⁹ years. Its only reference to the wide range of half-lives is in words: 'decay in milliseconds' and 'billions of years'.

factual_errors.text: (2) A short half-life means the dose falls quickly after the scan.
factual_errors.correction: The radiation dose builds up over time and does not 'fall'. What falls quickly is the activity, or dose rate, of the tracer. Because of this, the patient's total dose stays low.
